pages.text: You might want more mounds, either to obtain more resources or obtain new Mounds capable of placing a Structure Block. There are three ways to achieve this:$(br2)The first one is to let a chest with at least one food item (such as a piece of Biomass) not too far from a Mound. Stage 3 and 4 Mounds will eventually detect it and grow a Mound on this chest, feeding on the food at their disposal.

Every puff, a Stage 3 or 4 Mound has a 10% chance to look for a container nearby containing food, and will not do it if there is a player less than 8 blocks from the container or the Mound. As such, it can take some time to create new Mounds this way, although this is probably the safest way.

The second way is to wait for Scamper. Scampers are strange looking Spore creatures, which you can recognize easily as they look weird and walk veeeeery slowly. Stage 4 Mounds spawn them every 10 minutes. If a Scamper exists for more than 10 minutes, they will usually turn into two or three Mounds, or more rarely into a Gastgeber, which is a dangerous evolved creature that has stronger infecting capabilites than a Mound, and can move, although it cannot place structure blocks.

The third way is to craft an Infested Spawner. See: $(l:inf_infested_spawner)Infested Spawner$(/l) for more information. Make sure to read this entry before placing an Infested Spawner, as it can be a quite hazardous block. Note that despite its name, this block doesn't really function like a standard Spawner.
